mapper.insert: INSERT INTO documents (created_by_user_id, owner_user_id, work_case_id, document_type, status, issued_on, expires_on) VALUES (#{createdByUserId}, #{ownerUserId}, #{workCaseId}, #{documentType}, #{status}, #{issuedOn}, #{expiresOn})

INSERT INTO document_versions (document_id, version_no, version_type, storage_key, mime_type, size_bytes, checksum) VALUES (#{documentId}, #{versionNo}, #{versionType}, #{storageKey}, #{mimeType}, #{sizeBytes}, #{checksum})

INSERT INTO document_signatures (document_id, source_version_id, signed_version_id, signer_user_id, source_checksum, signed_checksum, typed_name, signature_method, consented_at, signed_at) VALUES (#{documentId}, #{sourceVersionId}, #{signedVersionId}, #{signerUserId}, #{sourceChecksum}, #{signedChecksum}, #{typedName}, #{signatureMethod}, #{consentedAt}, #{signedAt})
INSERT INTO document_shares (document_id, work_case_id, shared_with_user_id, purpose) VALUES (#{documentId}, #{workCaseId}, #{sharedWithUserId}, #{purpose})
mapper.update: UPDATE documents SET status = 'DELETED' WHERE id = #{documentId} AND document_type = 'HEALTH_CERTIFICATE' AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT dv.document_id AS documentId, dv.version_no AS versionNo, dv.version_type AS versionType, dv.storage_key AS storageKey, dv.checksum AS checksum FROM documents d JOIN document_versions dv ON dv.document_id = d.id WHERE d.work_case_id = #{workCaseId} AND d.document_type = 'EMPLOYMENT_CONTRACT'
